song.lyrics:
[C1] Chorus: . Em God, He is faithful . C Faithful to us . G Through troubled waters . D He won't abandon . Em Fear not! . C G The Lord God is with us
[V1] Verse 1: .Em C Be strong, take heart .G D The Lord He fights for us .Em C Hold on; our God .G D Is a mighty warrior
[V2] Verse 2: Be still and rest He holds the universe Lift high your hands To the Rock unshakable
[B1] Bridge: . Em The truth is a sword . C The battle is the Lord's . G D Surely He will deliver . Em So call on His name . C He is mighty to save . G D Surely He will deliver [x2
song.title: Fear Not
song.author: Chris Tomlin
